paragraphs.text: Effie is a Survivor on Duskmourn .

Despite her unassuming appearance, Effie is a killer of some of Duskmourn 's most dangerous inhabitants - Razorkin . With one of their masks strapped to her belt, she wields an impressively crafted weapon and strikes a bold countenance despite the terrors of the House . She wears her voluminous, curly ginger hair partially tied back from her spectacled face, and she wears a large, thick sweater with a heavy but slightly tattered skirt, solid boots, and combat gloves, and has a wicked machete strapped to her belt next to her Razorkin trophy.
